name: fail2ban Detection Suite
summary: Decoder and rules for fail2ban, which Wazuh ships no support for at all.
summary_zh: fail2ban 的解碼器與規則。Wazuh 完全沒有內建對 fail2ban 的支援。
notes: Wazuh 4.14.7 ships no fail2ban decoder and no fail2ban rules. Verified by feeding real log lines to wazuh-logtest, every one of which returned "No decoder matched".

The agent must collect /var/log/fail2ban.log, fail2ban's own logtarget. It does not write to syslog, so nothing arrives without an explicit localfile entry. Put that entry in a group of its own rather than in a product group: fail2ban runs on mail servers, web servers, jump hosts and anything else facing the internet, and tying its collection to one product leaves every other host running it invisible.
A ban and the unban that ends it are both reported. The pair is what makes an incident readable afterwards: when the block started and when it lifted.

A ban of an RFC 1918 address is graded above a ban of an external one. An outside address failing authentication is background noise; an inside host doing it is either a client left with a stale password or a machine working through credentials.
The address is decoded into srcip, so these events correlate with the rest of the ruleset and are usable by an active response command.
PREREQUISITE - the base rule requires the event to come from a file named fail2ban. If the log is collected under a different name, adjust <location> in rule 131000.
"[jail] address already banned" is not decoded: its address precedes the verb, which no single <order> can express alongside the other forms, and it adds nothing to the ban that already alerted.
notes_zh: Wazuh 4.14.7 完全沒有內建 fail2ban 的解碼器與規則。以真實記錄餵給 wazuh-logtest 驗證過，每一種格式都是 No decoder matched。
agent 必須收集 /var/log/fail2ban.log，那是 fail2ban 自己的 logtarget。它不寫 syslog，沒有明確的 localfile 設定就什麼都收不到。這條設定要放在**獨立的群組**而非某個產品群組底下：fail2ban 會跑在郵件伺服器、網頁伺服器、跳板機等任何對外的主機上，把收集綁在單一產品上，其他跑 fail2ban 的主機就全部看不到了。
封鎖與解除封鎖都會告警。這一對才能讓事後判讀完整：什麼時候擋起來、什麼時候解除。
封鎖對象若是 RFC 1918 位址，等級高於外部位址。外部位址認證失敗是網路日常；內部主機這樣做，不是用戶端留著舊密碼，就是那台機器在逐一試帳密。
位址解碼到 srcip 欄位，因此可與規則集其他部分關聯，也能被主動回應指令使用。
前提條件 - 基礎規則要求事件來自檔名含 fail2ban 的來源。若以其他名稱收集，請調整規則 131000 的 <location>。
「[jail] 位址 already banned」不做解碼：它的位址在動詞之前，單一 <order> 無法同時表達兩種順序，而且它並未提供封鎖告警以外的資訊。
author: Jason Tools
